title: Constitutional Review — Final Session
description: If the constitution is in force, this is your last opportunity to review its provisions before the year ends. If not, consider what remains undone.

title: Budget Allocation — Year-End Review
description: Three weeks remaining. The final budget adjustments before the year closes. Every number tells the story of what you chose to fund — and what you chose to cut.

title: Family — What We Built
description: They're still here. Not because they had nowhere else to go — because they chose to stay. Jonas, Liora, Tomas. The people who know you without the title. The people who stayed even when the title was all you had left.

title: Jonas — The Decision
description: The papers are still on your desk. Unsigned. He hasn't asked about them. He's been in the guest room for weeks. The silence between you is heavier than any argument. The question is whether you break it or let it become permanent.

title: Diplomatic Endgame — Final Negotiations
description: The negotiations are entering their final phase. Whatever is agreed now will be the framework for the next decade of Veltrian foreign relations. The question is what you're willing to trade for peace.
